t: Top 5 Types of Documents/Evidence to Gather for Your Purchase and Sale of Residence Case | LegalMatch
s: January 7, 2025 - In essence, the title to real estate stands as the main evidence of ownership. Escrow Documents: These confirm the secure handling of funds and other assets until the transaction conditions are met. Property Inspection Reports: Often obtained prior to finalizing the sale, these provide a detailed account of the property’s condition and can help identify any potential undisclosed issues. Communications between Parties: Emails, texts, or letters exchanged between the buyer and seller might be important, especially if there are any oral agreements that could be subject to the parol evidence rule in real estate.
